items.title: Diagnostic Utility of Novel and Established Spinal MRI Signs in AQP4-IgG-Seropositive NMOSD Myelitis.
items.abstract: Myelitis is a common manifestation of aquaporin-4 immunoglobulin G-seropositive (AQP4-IgG+) neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD), with longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis (LETM) as a characteristic MRI feature. Bright spotty lesions (BSLs) and a novel "double-contoured LETM" sign have also been increasingly observed, but their prevalence and diagnostic utility are unclear. This study aimed to characterize spinal cord MRI findings and evaluate the diagnostic performance of established and novel MRI signs in AQP4-IgG+ NMOSD myelitis. We retrospectively reviewed spinal cord MRI scans from adults with AQP4-IgG+ NMOSD myelitis at a university-based hospital across acute (<30 days), subacute (1-3 months), and remission (>3 months) stages. MRI features were descriptively analyzed. Acute scans were assessed for specific MRI signs, including the H sign, double-contoured LETM sign, BSLs, and sagittal ring enhancement and compared with other causes of myelopathy. Sensitivity, specificity, and likelihood ratios were calculated. Among 217 patients with AQP4-IgG+ NMOSD (median age at onset 44.5 years, 95.9% women), 170 (78.3%) experienced myelitis. A total of 331 NMOSD spinal MRI scans were reviewed. The comparison group included 72 scans, most commonly from patients with spinal cord infarction (39) and idiopathic transverse myelitis (14). Restricting the analysis to first-ever myelitis (53 scans), LETM was observed in 88.7%, and sensitivities of BSLs, the double-contoured LETM sign, and sagittal ring enhancement were 64.0% (95% CI 50.1%-75.9%), 47.2% (95% CI 34.4%-60.3%), and 60.0% (95% CI 46.2%-72.4%), respectively, with specificities of 98.6% (95% CI 92.2%-99.7%), 98.6% (95% CI 92.4%-99.8%), and 96.4% (95% CI 87.9%-99.0%). Combining these signs increased specificity further but reduced sensitivity to approximately 30%. When acute first-ever and recurrent myelitis were analyzed together (161 scans), the prevalence of these signs decreased to 56.5%, 19.9%, and 44.1%, respectively. During remission, complete radiologic resolution was observed in 12.4% of 129 scans, whereas spinal cord atrophy was present in 56.6%. BSLs, the double-contoured LETM sign, and sagittal ring enhancement demonstrate high specificity and may aid in differentiating NMOSD from other causes of longitudinally extensive myelopathy. The double-contoured LETM sign represents a novel imaging feature, particularly in first-ever acute myelitis. However, the comparison cohort was enriched with noninflammatory myelopathies, which may limit generalizability. Further validation in independent cohorts is warranted.
items.summary_ja:
背景：AQP4-IgG陽性NMOSDの脊髄炎では、特徴的なMRI所見として長大横断性脊髄炎（LETM）が知られているが、新たに報告された「二重輪郭LETMサイン」や明るい斑点病変（BSLs）の診断的有用性は不明である。  
方法：大学病院でAQP4-IgG陽性NMOSD患者の急性期（30日未満）、亜急性期（1～3ヶ月）、寛解期（3ヶ月以上）の脊髄MRIを後ろ向きに解析し、既存および新規のMRIサインの感度・特異度を他の脊髄疾患と比較した。  
結果：217例中170例が脊髄炎を呈し、331件のNMOSD脊髄MRIを評価。初回発症の脊髄炎53件ではLETMが88.7％に認められ、BSLs、二重輪郭LETMサイン、矢状面リング造影の感度はそれぞれ64.0％、47.2％、60.0％、特異度は98％以上であった。これらのサインを組み合わせると特異度は向上するが感度は低下した。寛解期では12.4％で画像所見が消失し、56.6％で脊髄萎縮を認めた。  
結論：BSLsや二重輪郭LETMサイン、矢状面リング造影は高い特異度を持ち、NMOSDの診断補助に有用である。特に二重輪郭LETMサインは初回急性期に特徴的だが、非炎症性疾患が多い比較群の影響もあり、さらなる検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: AQP4-IgG陽性NMOSDの脊髄炎において、従来のLETMに加え、新規の「ダブルコンツアLETM」サインや明るい斑点病変（BSLs）、矢状面リング造影が高い特異性を示し、他の原因の脊髄障害との鑑別に有用であることが示された。特に初発急性期での診断価値が高いが、非炎症性疾患を多く含む比較群のため、さらなる検証が必要である。

items.title: Diagnostic Yield and Therapeutic Impact of Etiologic Investigations After Status Epilepticus: Insights From the ICTAL Registry.
items.abstract: Status epilepticus (SE) is a critical neurologic emergency requiring prompt symptomatic and etiologic treatment. However, the diagnostic yield of etiologic investigations remains poorly characterized. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic yield and therapeutic impact of etiologic investigations in SE, using pretest probability strata. This prospective multicenter cohort study based on the ICTAL registry was conducted in 26 university-affiliated intensive care units (ICUs) in France (2018-2025). All adults (≥18 years) admitted for SE were included. Participants underwent a predefined diagnostic protocol including brain imaging (CT scan/MRI), laboratory investigations, lumbar puncture, toxicology screening, antiseizure medication (ASM) assays, and paraneoplastic/autoimmune disease workup. The primary outcome was the diagnostic yield of each test, defined as confirmation, codiagnosis, or reclassification of SE etiology. The secondary outcome was management changes directly attributable to test results. Among 1,123 patients (64% male; median age 60 years), SE was motor-predominant in 90%. Across high pretest probability strata, first-line investigations confirmed the suspected etiology in 8.5%-44.5% of cases and reclassified it in 22.1%-35.1%. Confirmation rates were the highest for toxicology screening in alcohol/toxic/iatrogenic causes (44.5%), ASM assays in precipitating factors (44.0%), paraneoplastic/autoimmune workup in noninfectious encephalitis (40.0%), brain CT in vascular causes (28.0%) and brain tumor (27.7%), laboratory investigations in metabolic causes (21.4%), and lumbar puncture in CNS infection (17.2%). Reclassification was most evident for brain MRI (27.8%-35.1%) across CNS infection, metabolic, noninfectious encephalitis, and sequelae strata, with the highest rate in noninfectious encephalitis (35.1%); brain CT contributed similarly (22.1%-27.9%). Toxicology screening reclassified 32.4% of high pretest probability metabolic presentations. Management changes were most frequent following brain MRI (up to 58.3%), brain CT (up to 56.9%), lumbar puncture (39.4%), paraneoplastic/autoimmune workup (33.3%), and ASM assays (up to 35.1%). Diagnostic yield and therapeutic impact of investigations in SE are strongly influenced by pretest clinical probability. Stratified diagnostic strategies may optimize etiologic identification and guide timely, targeted interventions. The study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, number NCT03457831.
items.summary_ja:
背景：てんかん重積状態（SE）は迅速な症状緩和と原因治療が必要な神経救急であるが、原因検索の診断的有用性は十分に明らかでない。  
方法：フランスの26大学付属ICUで2018～2025年に実施されたICTALレジストリに基づく前向き多施設コホート研究。18歳以上のSE患者1,123例を対象に、脳画像（CT/MRI）、検査室検査、腰椎穿刺、毒物検査、抗てんかん薬測定、パルアニュープラスティック/自己免疫疾患検査を含む標準化された診断プロトコルを実施。  
結果：高い事前確率群では、第一選択検査で原因確定率は8.5～44.5%、再分類率は22.1～35.1%であった。毒物検査はアルコール・中毒・医原性原因で44.5%、抗てんかん薬測定は誘因で44.0%、自己免疫検査は非感染性脳炎で40.0%の確定率を示した。MRIは非感染性脳炎で35.1%の再分類率を示し、CTも同様の貢献をした。診断結果に基づく治療変更はMRI（最大58.3%）、CT（最大56.9%）、腰椎穿刺（39.4%）で多かった。  
結論：SEにおける原因検索の診断的有用性と治療影響は事前確率に強く依存し、層別化された診断戦略が原因同定と適時の治療介入を最適化する可能性が示された。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、てんかん重積状態（SE）患者1,123例を対象に、原因検索の診断的有用性と治療への影響を前検査確率別に評価した。毒物検査や抗てんかん薬測定、自己免疫検査、脳画像検査などが原因確定や再分類に寄与し、特に脳MRIやCT、腰椎穿刺が診断と治療方針変更に大きく貢献した。前検査確率に基づく層別化診断戦略が、迅速かつ的確な介入に有効であることを示した。
